name: Siraj ud-Daulah
contribution: As Nawab of Bengal, Siraj ud-Daulah challenged East India Company encroachment, captured Calcutta in 1756, and commanded Bengal’s forces at Plassey in 1757.
context: His short reign unfolded amid disputes over fortification, trade privileges, court succession, and sovereignty between the Bengal Subah and the Company.
impact: His defeat at Plassey became a major turning point in the transfer of political influence from Bengal’s court to the East India Company.
highlight: The last independent Nawab of Bengal before Plassey shifted political power toward the East India Company.
seoTitle: Siraj ud-Daulah: Nawab of Bengal and the Battle of Plassey
seoDescription: Learn about Siraj ud-Daulah’s conflict with the East India Company, the capture of Calcutta, and Bengal’s defeat at Plassey in 1757.
shortAnswer: Siraj ud-Daulah was the Nawab of Bengal whose conflict with the East India Company culminated in the Battle of Plassey in 1757.
